zh-CN.help.title: 使用说明
zh-CN.help.body:
① 依次选择 Source、Branch、Target System、Subtarget 和 Target Profile；各项必须来自同一份 Catalog
② 勾选需要的插件；灰色表示当前 Catalog 不提供，兼容性规则和 Defconfig 的实际处理会写入构建日志
③ 等待 Target 与 menuconfig 加载完成，再填写固件设置并提交 Issue；也可加载 JSON、.config 或 config.buildinfo
④ Actions 完成后，直接下载单独的“时间戳-原文件名.img.gz”；CONFIG、BUILD-LOGS、OPTIONAL-PACKAGES、FIRMWARE-OTHER 是分类资料，统一保留 60 天
⑤ 首刷通常用 factory；sysupgrade 只适用于设备和分区布局都兼容的升级。不确定就不要刷

zh-CN.probe.v3.intro: 选择本次要验证的软件包，并在当前 Catalog 的真实 Source / Branch / Target 环境中进行兼容性探测。
zh-CN.probe.v3.howTo: Probe 与 Advanced menuconfig 共用同一份 Kconfig 状态；用户直接选择与 Kconfig 自动联动分开记录，但依赖关系仍只由 Catalog Kconfig 计算。进入上游源码后，实际依赖构建顺序交给上游 Make。

zh-CN.probe.v3.comparisonHelp: 默认按 B→A 执行配对对照；取消勾选后改为 Final-only，只执行加入所选插件的最终配置。B 会排除本次直接选择的软件包，也不主动保留经 Defconfig 消失的无用自动依赖；B 成功后，A 再加入所选插件，由 Make 重新解析并补齐依赖闭包。
zh-CN.probe.v3.comparisonMatrix: 每个环境仍只占一个 Matrix Job，不会因 A/B 翻倍。
zh-CN.probe.v3.comparisonShared: 同一 Job 共用 bootstrap、clone 与 feeds。
zh-CN.probe.v3.comparisonOrder: 顺序：B（排除插件）→ A（加入插件并由 Make 解析依赖）。
zh-CN.probe.v3.comparisonShortCircuit: B 失败时短路 A，不继续执行 Final。
zh-CN.probe.v3.comparisonSampling: 覆盖抽样先选环境，再在每个环境执行 B→A。
zh-CN.probe.v3.comparisonDeep: L2-L7：执行本层完整验证；A/B 共用同一 Job 的公共准备阶段。
zh-CN.probe.v3.comparisonCaveat: A/B 是同一 Matrix Job 内的配对对照；B 只用于判断共享基线，不能把 B 失败归因于插件。
zh-CN.probe.v3.packageCompileHelp: L1：以用户直接选择的软件包为 Root，解析上游 package metadata 后，以一次 Make 调用进入上游依赖图；不自行逐包调度依赖。
zh-CN.probe.v3.rootfsIntegrationHelp: L2：包含 L1，并执行上游 package/install，用完整 Final 状态检查 APK/OPKG 文件归属、路径冲突与共同安装问题。
zh-CN.probe.v3.firmwareIntegrationHelp: L3：在同一个真实环境中分别构建 Probe 打开时的 Baseline 与用户选择后的 Final 固件；Baseline 本身失败时不归因给插件。
zh-CN.probe.v3.bootSmokeHelp: L4：在 L3 Final 固件成功后，对 Catalog 认可的可启动环境执行通用 QEMU 启动自检；不是插件服务或真实硬件功能测试。

zh-TW.help.title: 使用說明
zh-TW.help.body:
① 依序選擇 Source、Branch、Target System、Subtarget 與 Target Profile；各項必須來自同一份 Catalog
② 勾選需要的套件；灰色表示目前 Catalog 不提供，推薦項與 Defconfig 的實際處理會寫入建置日誌
③ 等待 Target 與 menuconfig 載入完成，再填寫韌體設定並送出 Issue；也可載入 JSON、.config 或 config.buildinfo
④ Actions 完成後，直接下載獨立的「時間戳-原檔名.img.gz」；CONFIG、BUILD-LOGS、OPTIONAL-PACKAGES、FIRMWARE-OTHER 是分類資料。韌體/設定保留 60 天，日誌保留 60 天
⑤ 首次刷機通常使用 factory；sysupgrade 僅適用於裝置與分割區配置都相容的升級。不確定就不要刷

ru.help.title: Как пользоваться
ru.help.body:
① Последовательно выберите Source, Branch, Target System, Subtarget и Target Profile;все значения должны относиться к одному Catalog
② Выберите нужные пакеты;серый цвет означает отсутствие в текущем Catalog. Решения Recommended и Defconfig записываются в журнал сборки
③ Дождитесь загрузки Target и menuconfig, затем задайте параметры прошивки и отправьте Issue;также можно загрузить JSON, .config или config.buildinfo
④ После Actions скачивайте каждый исходный .img.gz с меткой времени напрямую. CONFIG, BUILD-LOGS, OPTIONAL-PACKAGES и FIRMWARE-OTHER содержат вспомогательные файлы. Прошивки/конфиги хранятся 60 дней, журналы — 60
⑤ Для первой прошивки обычно используют factory;sysupgrade подходит только при совместимых устройстве и разметке. Если не уверены, не прошивайте

ru.probe.v3.intro: Choose the packages to validate and probe them across real Source / Branch / Target environments from the current Catalog.
ru.probe.v3.howTo: Probe shares one Kconfig state with Advanced menuconfig. Direct user intent is recorded separately from automatic Kconfig changes, while dependency truth remains in Catalog Kconfig. Once inside upstream source, build ordering belongs to upstream Make.

ru.probe.v3.rootfsIntegrationHelp: L2: Includes L1 and runs upstream package/install with the complete Final state to expose APK/OPKG ownership, path, and co-install conflicts.

ru.probe.v3.bootSmokeHelp: L4: After a successful L3 Final firmware build, run generic QEMU boot smoke on Catalog-approved bootable environments. This is not package-service or real-hardware functional testing.

es.help.body:
① Elige Source, Branch, Target System, Subtarget y Target Profile en orden;todos deben proceder del mismo Catalog
② Marca los paquetes necesarios;gris significa que no están en el Catalog actual. Las decisiones Recommended y Defconfig quedan en el registro de compilación
③ Espera a que terminen de cargar Target y menuconfig, configura el firmware y envía el Issue;también se admiten JSON, .config y config.buildinfo
④ Al terminar Actions, descarga directamente cada .img.gz original con marca de tiempo. CONFIG, BUILD-LOGS, OPTIONAL-PACKAGES y FIRMWARE-OTHER contienen archivos auxiliares. Firmware/configuración duran 60 días y los registros 60

es.probe.v3.title: Package Compatibility Probe
es.probe.v3.intro: Choose the packages to validate and probe them across real Source / Branch / Target environments from the current Catalog.
es.probe.v3.howTo: Probe shares one Kconfig state with Advanced menuconfig. Direct user intent is recorded separately from automatic Kconfig changes, while dependency truth remains in Catalog Kconfig. Once inside upstream source, build ordering belongs to upstream Make.
es.probe.v3.defconfigHelp: Run the selected Source's own make defconfig to normalize the submitted state with upstream Kconfig. Disabled by default and runs only when explicitly enabled.
es.probe.v3.packageCompileHelp: L1: Treat directly selected packages as roots, resolve their upstream package metadata, and enter the upstream dependency graph with one Make invocation. Probe does not schedule dependencies package by package.
es.probe.v3.rootfsIntegrationHelp: L2: Includes L1 and runs upstream package/install with the complete Final state to expose APK/OPKG ownership, path, and co-install conflicts.
es.probe.v3.firmwareIntegrationHelp: L3: Build the Baseline captured when Probe opened and the user-modified Final firmware in the same real environment. A failing Baseline is not attributed to the package.
es.probe.v3.bootSmokeHelp: L4: After a successful L3 Final firmware build, run generic QEMU boot smoke on Catalog-approved bootable environments. This is not package-service or real-hardware functional testing.

pt.help.body:
① Escolha Source, Branch, Target System, Subtarget e Target Profile em ordem;todos devem vir do mesmo Catalog
② Marque os pacotes necessários;cinza significa indisponível no Catalog atual. As decisões Recommended e Defconfig ficam no log da compilação
③ Aguarde Target e menuconfig terminarem de carregar, configure o firmware e envie o Issue;também é possível carregar JSON, .config ou config.buildinfo
④ Ao terminar o Actions, baixe diretamente cada .img.gz original com carimbo de data. CONFIG, BUILD-LOGS, OPTIONAL-PACKAGES e FIRMWARE-OTHER contêm arquivos auxiliares. Firmware/configurações ficam 60 dias e logs 60

pt.probe.v3.title: Package Compatibility Probe
pt.probe.v3.intro: Choose the packages to validate and probe them across real Source / Branch / Target environments from the current Catalog.
pt.probe.v3.howTo: Probe shares one Kconfig state with Advanced menuconfig. Direct user intent is recorded separately from automatic Kconfig changes, while dependency truth remains in Catalog Kconfig. Once inside upstream source, build ordering belongs to upstream Make.
pt.probe.v3.defconfigHelp: Run the selected Source's own make defconfig to normalize the submitted state with upstream Kconfig. Disabled by default and runs only when explicitly enabled.
pt.probe.v3.packageCompileHelp: L1: Treat directly selected packages as roots, resolve their upstream package metadata, and enter the upstream dependency graph with one Make invocation. Probe does not schedule dependencies package by package.
pt.probe.v3.rootfsIntegrationHelp: L2: Includes L1 and runs upstream package/install with the complete Final state to expose APK/OPKG ownership, path, and co-install conflicts.
pt.probe.v3.firmwareIntegrationHelp: L3: Build the Baseline captured when Probe opened and the user-modified Final firmware in the same real environment. A failing Baseline is not attributed to the package.
pt.probe.v3.bootSmokeHelp: L4: After a successful L3 Final firmware build, run generic QEMU boot smoke on Catalog-approved bootable environments. This is not package-service or real-hardware functional testing.

pt.probe.v3.cancelInstruction: To cancel after submission, reply with exactly /cancel in the same Issue.
pt.probe.v3.permission: Execution permission and concurrency caps are decided server-side from the real Issue author and repository permission; browser parameters cannot elevate permission.
pt.probe.v3.retention: Normalized evidence and complete logs continue to follow the current Catalog retention policy.

ja.help.title: 使い方
ja.help.body:
① Source、Branch、Target System、Subtarget、Target Profile の順に選びます。すべて同じ Catalog の値を使用してください
② 必要なパッケージを選びます。グレーは現在の Catalog で提供されていません。Recommended と Defconfig の処理結果はビルドログに記録されます
③ Target と menuconfig の読み込み完了後、ファームウェア設定を入力して Issue を送信します。JSON、.config、config.buildinfo も読み込めます
④ Actions 完了後、タイムスタンプ付きの元の .img.gz を個別に直接取得します。CONFIG、BUILD-LOGS、OPTIONAL-PACKAGES、FIRMWARE-OTHER は補助資料です。ファームウェア/設定は60日、ログは60日保持されます
⑤ 初回書き込みは通常 factory を使います。sysupgrade は機器とパーティション構成が互換の場合だけです。不明なら書き込まないでください

ja.probe.v3.title: Package Compatibility Probe
ja.probe.v3.intro: Choose the packages to validate and probe them across real Source / Branch / Target environments from the current Catalog.
ja.probe.v3.howTo: Probe shares one Kconfig state with Advanced menuconfig. Direct user intent is recorded separately from automatic Kconfig changes, while dependency truth remains in Catalog Kconfig. Once inside upstream source, build ordering belongs to upstream Make.

ja.probe.v3.rootfsIntegrationHelp: L2: Includes L1 and runs upstream package/install with the complete Final state to expose APK/OPKG ownership, path, and co-install conflicts.
ja.probe.v3.firmwareIntegrationHelp: L3: Build the Baseline captured when Probe opened and the user-modified Final firmware in the same real environment. A failing Baseline is not attributed to the package.
ja.probe.v3.bootSmokeHelp: L4: After a successful L3 Final firmware build, run generic QEMU boot smoke on Catalog-approved bootable environments. This is not package-service or real-hardware functional testing.

ko.help.title: 사용 방법
ko.help.body:
① Source, Branch, Target System, Subtarget, Target Profile 순서로 선택합니다. 모든 값은 같은 Catalog에 속해야 합니다
② 필요한 패키지를 선택합니다. 회색은 현재 Catalog에 없다는 뜻이며 Recommended와 Defconfig 처리 결과는 빌드 로그에 기록됩니다
③ Target과 menuconfig 로딩이 끝난 뒤 펌웨어 설정을 입력하고 Issue를 제출합니다. JSON, .config, config.buildinfo도 불러올 수 있습니다

de.probe.v3.title: Package Compatibility Probe
de.probe.v3.intro: Choose the packages to validate and probe them across real Source / Branch / Target environments from the current Catalog.
de.probe.v3.howTo: Probe shares one Kconfig state with Advanced menuconfig. Direct user intent is recorded separately from automatic Kconfig changes, while dependency truth remains in Catalog Kconfig. Once inside upstream source, build ordering belongs to upstream Make.
de.probe.v3.defconfigHelp: Run the selected Source's own make defconfig to normalize the submitted state with upstream Kconfig. Disabled by default and runs only when explicitly enabled.
de.probe.v3.packageCompileHelp: L1: Treat directly selected packages as roots, resolve their upstream package metadata, and enter the upstream dependency graph with one Make invocation. Probe does not schedule dependencies package by package.
de.probe.v3.rootfsIntegrationHelp: L2: Includes L1 and runs upstream package/install with the complete Final state to expose APK/OPKG ownership, path, and co-install conflicts.
de.probe.v3.firmwareIntegrationHelp: L3: Build the Baseline captured when Probe opened and the user-modified Final firmware in the same real environment. A failing Baseline is not attributed to the package.
de.probe.v3.bootSmokeHelp: L4: After a successful L3 Final firmware build, run generic QEMU boot smoke on Catalog-approved bootable environments. This is not package-service or real-hardware functional testing.
de.probe.v3.submittedState: The Probe V3 state was carried into the GitHub Issue.
de.probe.v3.stateInstruction: Probe V3 transports Baseline, direct user Intent, Final PACKAGE_* state, five-dimensional environment constraints, and coverage controls. It does not transport a dependency table, build order, or second package database.
de.probe.v3.cancelInstruction: To cancel after submission, reply with exactly /cancel in the same Issue.
de.probe.v3.permission: Execution permission and concurrency caps are decided server-side from the real Issue author and repository permission; browser parameters cannot elevate permission.
de.probe.v3.retention: Normalized evidence and complete logs continue to follow the current Catalog retention policy.

fr.help.title: Mode d'emploi
fr.help.body:
① Sélectionnez Source, Branch, Target System, Subtarget et Target Profile dans l’ordre;toutes les valeurs doivent venir du même Catalog
② Cochez les paquets nécessaires;grisé signifie absent du Catalog actuel. Les décisions Recommended et Defconfig sont consignées dans le journal de compilation
③ Attendez la fin du chargement de Target et menuconfig, réglez le firmware puis envoyez l’Issue;JSON, .config et config.buildinfo peuvent aussi être chargés
④ Une fois Actions terminé, téléchargez directement chaque .img.gz d’origine horodaté. CONFIG, BUILD-LOGS, OPTIONAL-PACKAGES et FIRMWARE-OTHER contiennent les fichiers annexes. Firmware/configurations restent 60 jours, journaux 60 jours
⑤ Le premier flash utilise généralement factory;sysupgrade seulement avec un appareil et un partitionnement compatibles. En cas de doute, ne flashez pas

fr.probe.v3.title: Package Compatibility Probe
fr.probe.v3.intro: Choose the packages to validate and probe them across real Source / Branch / Target environments from the current Catalog.
fr.probe.v3.howTo: Probe shares one Kconfig state with Advanced menuconfig. Direct user intent is recorded separately from automatic Kconfig changes, while dependency truth remains in Catalog Kconfig. Once inside upstream source, build ordering belongs to upstream Make.
fr.probe.v3.defconfigHelp: Run the selected Source's own make defconfig to normalize the submitted state with upstream Kconfig. Disabled by default and runs only when explicitly enabled.
fr.probe.v3.packageCompileHelp: L1: Treat directly selected packages as roots, resolve their upstream package metadata, and enter the upstream dependency graph with one Make invocation. Probe does not schedule dependencies package by package.
fr.probe.v3.rootfsIntegrationHelp: L2: Includes L1 and runs upstream package/install with the complete Final state to expose APK/OPKG ownership, path, and co-install conflicts.
fr.probe.v3.firmwareIntegrationHelp: L3: Build the Baseline captured when Probe opened and the user-modified Final firmware in the same real environment. A failing Baseline is not attributed to the package.
fr.probe.v3.bootSmokeHelp: L4: After a successful L3 Final firmware build, run generic QEMU boot smoke on Catalog-approved bootable environments. This is not package-service or real-hardware functional testing.

fr.probe.v3.stateInstruction: Probe V3 transports Baseline, direct user Intent, Final PACKAGE_* state, five-dimensional environment constraints, and coverage controls. It does not transport a dependency table, build order, or second package database.
fr.probe.v3.cancelInstruction: To cancel after submission, reply with exactly /cancel in the same Issue.
fr.probe.v3.permission: Execution permission and concurrency caps are decided server-side from the real Issue author and repository permission; browser parameters cannot elevate permission.
fr.probe.v3.retention: Normalized evidence and complete logs continue to follow the current Catalog retention policy.

vi.help.title: Hướng dẫn sử dụng
vi.help.body:
① Chọn lần lượt Source, Branch, Target System, Subtarget và Target Profile;tất cả giá trị phải thuộc cùng một Catalog
② Chọn các gói cần dùng;màu xám nghĩa là Catalog hiện tại không cung cấp. Quyết định Recommended và Defconfig được ghi vào nhật ký build
③ Chờ Target và menuconfig tải xong, nhập thiết lập firmware rồi gửi Issue;cũng có thể nạp JSON, .config hoặc config.buildinfo
④ Khi Actions hoàn tất, tải trực tiếp từng tệp .img.gz gốc có dấu thời gian. CONFIG, BUILD-LOGS, OPTIONAL-PACKAGES và FIRMWARE-OTHER là tài liệu phụ. Firmware/cấu hình lưu 60 ngày, log lưu 60 ngày
⑤ Lần flash đầu thường dùng factory;sysupgrade chỉ dùng khi thiết bị và phân vùng tương thích. Không chắc thì đừng flash

vi.probe.v3.title: Package Compatibility Probe
vi.probe.v3.intro: Choose the packages to validate and probe them across real Source / Branch / Target environments from the current Catalog.
vi.probe.v3.howTo: Probe shares one Kconfig state with Advanced menuconfig. Direct user intent is recorded separately from automatic Kconfig changes, while dependency truth remains in Catalog Kconfig. Once inside upstream source, build ordering belongs to upstream Make.
vi.probe.v3.defconfigHelp: Run the selected Source's own make defconfig to normalize the submitted state with upstream Kconfig. Disabled by default and runs only when explicitly enabled.
vi.probe.v3.packageCompileHelp: L1: Treat directly selected packages as roots, resolve their upstream package metadata, and enter the upstream dependency graph with one Make invocation. Probe does not schedule dependencies package by package.
vi.probe.v3.rootfsIntegrationHelp: L2: Includes L1 and runs upstream package/install with the complete Final state to expose APK/OPKG ownership, path, and co-install conflicts.
vi.probe.v3.firmwareIntegrationHelp: L3: Build the Baseline captured when Probe opened and the user-modified Final firmware in the same real environment. A failing Baseline is not attributed to the package.
vi.probe.v3.bootSmokeHelp: L4: After a successful L3 Final firmware build, run generic QEMU boot smoke on Catalog-approved bootable environments. This is not package-service or real-hardware functional testing.
vi.probe.v3.submittedState: The Probe V3 state was carried into the GitHub Issue.
vi.probe.v3.stateInstruction: Probe V3 transports Baseline, direct user Intent, Final PACKAGE_* state, five-dimensional environment constraints, and coverage controls. It does not transport a dependency table, build order, or second package database.
vi.probe.v3.cancelInstruction: To cancel after submission, reply with exactly /cancel in the same Issue.
vi.probe.v3.permission: Execution permission and concurrency caps are decided server-side from the real Issue author and repository permission; browser parameters cannot elevate permission.
vi.probe.v3.retention: Normalized evidence and complete logs continue to follow the current Catalog retention policy.
